name: Shepherd Sessions
description: See which of your Shepherd coding-agent sessions are waiting on you and open one in a keystroke. Requires a self-hosted Shepherd core; read-only.
author: Kai Osthoff

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: Shepherd API base URL
preferences.description: Must not be localhost: Asyar blocks loopback, RFC1918 and link-local addresses before DNS resolution. Use the Tailnet FQDN of your Shepherd core.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API token
preferences.description: Sent as a bearer token on every request. Stored device-locally and excluded from cloud sync, so it must be entered again on each machine.

preferences.name: holdLanguage
preferences.title: Reason language
preferences.description: Language for the hold reasons. Auto follows your system language, matching the Shepherd HUD.

commands.name: Refresh sessions
commands.description: Background refresh of the session cache

actions.title: Open Shepherd HUD
actions.description: Open the Shepherd HUD root in your browser, with no session preselected.
